instruction: Scale the image to 265x447 pixels and export it as 'thumbnail.jpg' on the Desktop.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully exported image via File > Export As dialog, changed filename to export.jpg, navigated JPEG quality options, and completed export in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP menus, use Export As dialog, change filenames, handle JPEG export options, navigate file system within dialogs.
metadata.task_rationale: Adds image scaling step before export, testing GIMP's Image > Scale Image menu in addition to the proven export capability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires scaling the 530x894 image to half dimensions (265x447) then exporting as JPEG. Evaluator uses official check_image_size metric to verify the exported file has correct dimensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches the exported file from /home/user/Desktop/thumbnail.jpg, verifying both file existence and correct export location.
Metric check_image_size correctly receives the rules dict {width: 265, height: 447} and compares against the actual image dimensions using PIL Image.size.
Expected values (265x447) exactly match the instruction requirements.
Parameter handling is correct: with expected.type='rule', the metric receives the rules dict directly and accesses rule.get('width') and rule.get('height') — proper pattern.
Both instruction requirements are covered: (1) correct dimensions via check_image_size, (2) correct file name and location via vm_file getter path.
